# Embed

**Name:** `core/embed`
**Category:** [embed](/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-embed/)
**API Version:** [3](/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-api-versions/)
**Block Type:** [Static](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/) (saved in post content)

> Add a block that displays content pulled from other sites, like Twitter or YouTube.

## Block Markup

This is a [**static block**](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/). The markup is saved directly in the post content.

```html
<!-- wp:embed {"allowResponsive":true,"responsive":false,"previewable":true} -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:embed -->
```
